passages.text: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
All nations must praise the LORD.
All peoples must honor Him.
Everyone should give Him glory.
passages.original: הַֽלְל֣וּ אֶת־ יְ֭הוָה כָּל־ גּוֹיִ֑ם שַׁ֝בְּח֗וּהוּ כָּל־ הָאֻמִּֽים׃

passages.text: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
passages.sermon: The LORD shows great loving devotion to us.\r\nHis faithfulness lasts forever.\r\nPraise the LORD!
passages.original: כִּ֥י גָ֘בַ֤ר עָלֵ֨ינוּ׀ חַסְדּ֗וֹ וֶֽאֱמֶת־ יְהוָ֥ה לְעוֹלָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־ יָֽהּ׃
